lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, forming a repeating grid-like geometry.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, with high-luminance blobs localized at the intersections or centered within the resulting rectangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Presence of small, distinct high-luminance blobs of lower intensity than the primary flank clusters, distributed across the anterior and medial portion of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes consistent with commensal fish attached to the ventral surface and swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin.
